$comment: Dhanekula Institute of Engineering & Technology — the first customer tenant.
PROVISIONAL. The colour seeds and crest below are placeholders chosen to
look plausible for a JNTUK-affiliated institution; they are NOT the
college's official values. CLAUDE.md lists 'brand assets: DIET crest in
vector, official colour hex values' as blocked on the college. When those
arrive, edit this file and nothing else — no component, no stylesheet, no
rebuild of the design system.
Donations stay off until the college confirms FCRA registration status.
That is a legal gate, not a rollout preference: foreign contributions must
be segregated at the point of collection or not collected at all.
MEDIA AWAITED FROM THE COLLEGE. Every slot below renders nothing until it is filled: no empty frame, no 'photo coming soon'. Add a key only when its file exists.
Put files in public/brand/diet/ ('/brand/diet/...') or S3 ap-south-1 (https URL). Only photographs the college owns or has licensed; no identifiable students without consent.
crest: SVG. Hero, sign-in panel and footer, on a light disc.
logoPrimary: SVG for light grounds. logoInverse: SVG for the college-colour band.
heroImage: one landscape campus photograph, 2400x1350 or larger, WebP/AVIF/JPEG under 350 KB, with heroImageAlt (one sentence on what it shows) and optional heroFocus ('50% 40%').
heroVideo: optional 10-20 s silent loop, .mp4 (H.264) or .webm, 1920x1080, under 6 MB. Needs heroImage. Desktop only.
authImage: optional portrait-friendly photo for the desktop sign-in panel (falls back to heroImage).
campusPhotos: optional 3-8 photographs, each { src, alt (required), caption (optional), focus (optional) }.
Finished shape: see 'Media block' in the public-pages spec, section 6.4.
ogImage: optional 1200x630 share card. Until one exists the portal generates a card in the college's colours.
Deliberately absent until the college supplies them. Each renders nothing (or a neutral default) until then:
rollNumberExample (the printed format, confirmed by the examinations branch),
reviewTurnaround and supportTurnaround (only once the alumni cell commits to them), affiliationLine (the college's own wording),
websiteUrl, supportPhone, collegeMessage, announcements.
officeName defaults to 'alumni cell'. Confirm the office's own name with the college.
'Since <year>' returns to the tagline once the year of establishment is confirmed.
copy.heroSubhead: Find your batchmates, come back to campus, and help the final-year students coming up behind you.
